threads.body: [Testing] The new tests only cover successful batch execution. Please add a failure-then-retry case that verifies the original query/batch size is still reported after the first `executeBatch()` throws; retaining state on failure is an explicit part of this change and none of the existing JDBC batch tests exercise that branch. Ideally cover the analogous `executeLargeBatch()` path as well.

replies.body: Added failure-then-retry coverage for both `executeBatch()` and `executeLargeBatch()` across the shared library and javaagent test suite. The large-batch case also exposed and now covers the missing prepared-statement `executeLargeBatch()` override, so the retained query and batch size are reported on retry.
